case: Custom enum metadata and SQL with embedded-quote identifiers
contract: The test schema, enum type and table names contain spaces and embedded double quotes; metadata returns their exact unescaped names.
Generated keyed update and structured equality filter correctly double embedded identifier quotes in SQL.
Native pg_typeof text preserves PostgreSQL's quoted qualified type spelling, and the update leaves the sibling row unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_quoted_identifiers_support_keyed_edit_and_filter -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL session/search_path and identifier configurations remain open; this case does not close the enum or broader B3 matrix.
